description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - Mr. G. B. Amal Priyankara was elected as the Chairman of the Nawalapitiya Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the declaration of a Chairman for the Nawalapitiya Urban Council under Section 66g of the Local Government Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral results and declarations for local government authorities, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7). While it names an individual (Gossina Baduge Amal Priyankara), this is part of declaring an election result rather than a government personnel appointment with portfolio responsibilities, so it does not qualify as a People or Hybrid gazette.
